rows: Is the chair a craft solution to comfort, proportion, and wood joinery?
Shaped hardwood, paper cord or leather, visible joinery, restraint rather than austerity
Is furniture inseparable from an architectural commission?
Hotel, canteen, or building-specific constraints explain the shell, base, privacy, or stacking decision
Does the piece make seat/back elements appear to float inside a frame?
Sculptural separation of support frame from body-supporting elements
Does modernism stay wooden rather than becoming steel-and-glass?
Birch plywood, L-leg, bent laminated forms, clinical or civic functional brief
Is affordability part of the design brief rather than an afterthought?
Good design for ordinary people, craft-to-industry translation, low-price pressure
Is the object Scandinavian design or IKEA's cost-optimized descendant?
Flat-pack logistics, names/branding, particleboard or bentwood cost engineering, global scale
